# BIP-138 test vectors

Source repository: https://github.com/bitcoin/bips
Source commit: `5aadddb511a5dcfe4599531bd8ae5e5b96d0f793`, directory `bip-0138/test_vectors/`
License: BSD-2-Clause (the license BIP-138 states in its header)

The JSON files here are the official BIP-138 (Draft 0.1.3) test vectors,
copied unchanged. EntropyLab's encrypted descriptor backup is tested against
them; none of these values were produced by EntropyLab's own code.
